ticketingSold: Ticketing imports: {sold} sold. The source reported no scans.

fields.sourceReferenceHelp: Such as a hauler's invoice, a meter reading or a file name.
fields.headline: Headline
fields.reachHelp: Readers, viewers or listeners the outlet reports. Leave it blank when they report none.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.description: Measurable targets for this project. Gate 8 measures against them.
objectives.locked: Gate 1 has passed. Only a gate approver can change these objectives, and every change is logged.
objectives.empty: No objectives yet. Set a target for each figure gate 8 will measure.
objectives.attestNote: {count, plural, one {# measurable objective recorded.} other {# measurable objectives recorded.}}
objectives.attested: The objectives are evidence for gate 1 criterion G1.OBJECTIVES_STATED.

gate8.title: Measurement
gate8.description: Audience, earned media, sentiment and sustainability figures against the objectives set at gate 1. A figure nobody measured shows as Unmeasured, never zero.
gate8.attestNote: {met} of {count, plural, one {# objective} other {# objectives}} met.
gate8.attested: The measurement is evidence for gate 8 criterion G8.MEASUREMENT_REPORTED.

summary.caption: Objectives against measured figures
summary.unmeasuredBeside: {count, plural, one {# entry unmeasured} other {# entries unmeasured}}

figures.title: Measured figures
figures.notMeasuredHelp: Record that this figure was not measured. It shows as Unmeasured, never as zero.
figures.correctDescription: The figure before and after, and your reason, go in the correction log.
figures.reasonHelp: Say why the figure changes, such as a weighbridge ticket that replaces an estimate.
figures.withdrawDescription: The figure leaves the totals. The withdrawal goes in the correction log.

coverage.title: Earned media
coverage.description: Coverage of the project, each piece sourced, dated and linked. The coverage count and reach come from these pieces.
coverage.withdrawDescription: The piece leaves the coverage count and reach. You can restore it from Trash.

report.projectLead: Objectives are set at gate 1 and figures are recorded at gate 8.
report.partialProjects: {count, plural, one {# project has} other {# projects have}} unmeasured entries
report.empty: No objectives or figures yet. Set objectives on a project's Gates tab at gate 1.

errors.url: Enter a link that starts with https://.
errors.conflict: This is already recorded: one live objective per figure, and one coverage piece per link.
errors.not-found: This is gone or you cannot change it. Refresh the page.
errors.measurement_unit_dimension: That unit does not measure this figure. Choose one of its units.
errors.measurement_unit_required: Choose the unit of the figure.
errors.measurement_out_of_range: That figure is outside what this measure takes, such as a share above 100 percent.
errors.measurement_whole_count: A count is a whole number.
errors.measurement_in_future: A figure is measured on or before today on the project's calendar.
errors.measurement_metric_derived: Earned media figures come from the coverage pieces. Add coverage instead.
errors.measurement_correction_reason: Say why the figure is corrected.
errors.project_objectives_locked: Gate 1 has passed. Only a gate approver can change its objectives.
errors.project_objective_immutable: An objective keeps its figure. Withdraw it and set another.
errors.project_measurement_immutable: A figure keeps its project, measure and source. Withdraw it and record another.
errors.earned_media_in_future: Coverage runs on or before today on the project's calendar.
